objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object such as a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchy level of the document (Level 1 through Level 4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the document within its lifecycle (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity check, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is kept before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with write access to the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document content.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to approve and release the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment for read authorization.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or areas of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release lifecycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished status of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to request changes to an existing released document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise document validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate an invalidated (archived) document, permitted only by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning authorizations and distribution roles.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role associated with the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Archive).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles, authorizations, and workflow tasks.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the person.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configurable list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was provided.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type this template is associated with.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must go through its own check and release workflow.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Target language of the translation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the translated version (e.g. In Translation, Released).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The selected template used for creation.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature of the author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection of the review.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication in the release workflow step.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection of the release.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting its version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted from a document without creating a new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through the assigned workflow (by releasers or by author, reviewer, and releaser).

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Whether validity is extended or revision/override is needed.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the configured period.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the assigned workflow (by releasers or by initiator, reviewer, and releaser).

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Approval or rejection of the override.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Authorizations for a document are revoked, e.g., during archiving.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document via workflow task without signature.

evts.name: start_translation
evts.description: Translation of a released document into another language is initiated.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: The translated version is reviewed for correctness.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection of the translation review.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is approved and released, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform workflow participants about status changes or pending tasks.
